candidate.title: `require_dependency 'nokogiri'` can raise `LoadError` in Rails development due to `:load` dependency mechanism
reports: app/models/topicembed.rb:1 — requiredependency 'nokogiri' raises loaderror in dev-mode rails (cacheclasses=false → activesupport::dependencies.mechanism=:load) because searchforfile can't locate a gem named 'nokogiri' under an autoload path and falls back to kernelload('nokogiri'), and unlike require, load does not resolve extension-less filenames (verified: ruby -e "load 'set'" raises loaderror while require 'set' succeeds), so the topicembed model fails to load entirely outside of production/cacheclasses=true
